interface.signature: def palindromepair(arr: list[str], N: int) -> bool:

preconditions.description: The size N must exactly match the length of the input array arr.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr must have a length between 1 and 10 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in arr must be strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(arr[i] + arr[j] == (arr[i] + arr[j])[::-1] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there exists at least one pair of distinct strings (arr[i], arr[j]) in arr such that their concatenation is a palindrome, otherwise returns false.
